name: Aasivissuit – Nipisat. Inuit Hunting Ground between Ice and Sea
description: This stretch of West Greenland, north of the Arctic Circle, runs from the coastal island of Nipisat to Aasivissuit near the edge of the inland ice cap. Over about 4,200 years, successive peoples, including the Saqqaq, Dorset and Thule cultures, moved between coast and interior with the seasons. They left behind big winter house ruins and traces of caribou hunting that you can still see on the land.
